title: How The Mighty Have Fallen
text: How The Mighty Have Fallen. WOW, Very sad to see how far the Lenox name has fallen. In looking at the picture of this box my first impression was " it's a little plain but it will be better in person." Not so. It's butt ugly plain and if I were Lenox I would be embarrassed to put my name on it. The quality is OK but this sure could use a little spicing up as far as design is concerned.  I have some old pieces and there just is no comparison to this stuff in terms of quality or design.
